results.title: Why are paper ballots used for MLC polls? Explained
results.content: MLC elections use proportional representation through a single transferable vote. Voters rank candidates instead of picking just one. EVMs are built for “first-past-the-post elections” in India in which voter chooses one candidate, so they cannot record ranked preferences

results.title: Delhi BLOs to record reasons for removing names of eligible voters
